description:
Read your own timesheet for one week (Monday to Sunday), as the Timesheets grid shows it: days; rows you can book (initiatives, then the overhead categories keyed @meetings, @admin, @support, @learning, @hiring), each with days[].bookable and the reason when a day cannot take time; addable initiatives; blocked ones with the reason; and entries, every booked cell with initiativeId (or category key), date, minutes, note and source (manual = typed by a person, here or in the Console; auto = booked from a calendar or measured activity).

Read the week before anyforge_book_time and send only the cells that should change, so you do not overwrite what someone typed or a calendar booked.

date.description: Any day (YYYY-MM-DD) in the week to read. Left out: this week.

today.description: Your local date (YYYY-MM-DD), honoured within a day of UTC. Pass it when you are not on UTC, so yesterday and today mean yours.

name: anyforge_get_timesheet_week
title: Get timesheet week
